text:
Hi there all hands,
The senior handler mentioned a reminder about quiet areas before departure, and I wanted to pass it on so we stay consistent for every pet and traveler moving through Aurelia Skyways. Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm and uncluttered, and make sure carriers are settled away from loud doors, sudden roll calls, and other distractions that can unsettle animals. The welfare coordinator can still check comfort needs at the desk, and a steady handoff helps everyone feel more settled before boarding begins.

For the next stretch, please keep an eye on lounge flow and send any concerns through the usual channels early, especially if a pet seems worried or a family needs a little more reassurance. <<FACT F006>> The same goes for arrivals and handovers, where a quiet tone and simple instructions usually make the biggest difference. <<FACT F012>> If you notice a pet like Willow resting better in a calmer corner, please keep that setup in place and let the traveler know we are looking out for them.

Thanks for keeping things thoughtful and easy to follow. Small habits like this help the whole team do better work and help our animals travel more comfortably.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
